parsed.impact: Changes the side-panel description box (Action::Enter became Send/Cancel), go_to_box/box_wanted focus logic for `q`, and adds an async Reader that can open Dialog::QuickEntry at any time. It reuses create::keyed/wall, new_entry and the shared ollama::fake. A late model answer can now replace any open dialog (editor included), and a change to create::keyed/wall now also affects descriptions; the US-10-01 box tests still pass.

findings.text: crates/app/src/main.rs:2030 — user sends a description, then opens the editor (or presses `c`) and types while "Reading…" shows; when the answer arrives `self.dialog = Some(QuickEntry)` overwrites the dialog unconditionally and the unsaved edits are lost → apply the answer only when no dialog is open (otherwise hold it until the dialog closes, or drop it and keep the text in the box with a message), and add a test that sends, opens another dialog, releases the answer, and asserts the dialog is untouched

crates/app/src/main.rs:2018 — Ollama up but chat returns None (HTTP 500, non-JSON body, no content): "Reading…" vanishes with no message once the re-check says Available, though the story says an unusable answer shows the no-event message → also set description.no_event = true on None (the greyed box shows its own reason if Ollama is gone) and test it with a fake 500

crates/core/src/described_cases.json:1 — the fake model's recorded answers carry duration_min:60 where the sentence gives no length (the real prompt returns null per DEC-218), so the fake run does not exercise the new length rule; the 100 %/93 % figure in DEC-218 is a hand-run claim that cannot be checked here → record the answers as the new prompt gives them or note the limit; TC-10-19 stays the real evidence
crates/core/src/described.rs:118 — Described.guests/meet are parsed but unused until US-10-03 (DEC-219 justifies it); small speculative surface → keep or drop until US-10-03
crates/core/src/described.rs:155 — action "add" with an empty or blank title opens "New event" with an empty title instead of the no-event message → treat a blank title as NoEvent
crates/core/src/described.rs:194 — "29 lutego" in a non-leap year gives None, so the user gets "no event" → acceptable, noted only
crates/app/src/description.rs:1 — every focus spawns an HTTP request with no time limit (Reader::load), so repeated focusing piles up concurrent model-load requests → add a "loading in flight" flag

crates/app/src/main.rs:1991 — after Enter focus is surrendered, so Esc cancels only after `q` returns to the box; there is no cancel if the user clicks elsewhere → consistent with DEC-220 and TC-10-10 step 3, design note only
crates/app/src/description_reading_tests.rs:1 — no test of the no-calendar message (NO_CALENDAR) through the description path → add one case with every calendar disabled

criteria.note: TC-10-08; "same style" in light and dark themes is the owner's manual check
TC-10-10, but B1 shows a late answer can clobber a dialog opened meanwhile
TC-10-15 and TC-10-16; no logging in the diff
MANUAL TC-10-19 for the real model; the automated part (30 sentences, fake model, TC-10-18) is met, and DEC-221 defers the changing sentences to US-10-04
